answer: Anti-sybil via commit-reveal plus a slashing bond: every grader must lock 5,000 POA before grading, and its grade is only revealed after the epoch closes, so graders cannot copy the majority. An attacker flooding the epoch with 50 fake graders to push spiral, forge and zenith spam answers must lock 250,000 POA up front, and a single audit catching coordinated votes slashes the whole bond. Honest grading costs nothing but attention and earns a share of the pool, while a sybil farm pays a quarter-million POA to even try.
